Frequently Asked Dispatch Questions

How quickly is the site survey scheduled?

You can request your preferred time slot directly on submission. Our regional dispatch desk contacts the customer promptly to confirm site access and finalize the appointment.

What happens if the customer is not home?

For exterior-only surveys (outdoor MSP and walkable roof), homeowner presence is not required. For attic framing inspections or indoor battery gateways, our team coordinates an arrival window directly with the property contact.

How do we receive the completed survey package?

Your engineering team receives an encrypted cloud link containing 36+ categorized 4K geotagged photos, CAD dimension reports, and single-line electrical sheets.
